defects.description: Incorrect word order and lack of inflection for a section title; should be 'Манифест сессии'.
Incorrect case for the glossary term 'Фаза' after the preposition 'в' (should be accusative 'Фазу').
Incorrect case for the glossary term 'Согласие' after the verb 'считается' (should be instrumental 'согласием' or phrased as 'считается имеющей статус «Согласие»').
Incorrect case for the glossary term 'Роль' after 'наличия' (should be genitive 'Роли').
